environment.isolation: One Node process; no CPU affinity or machine-wide load isolation. Vite SSR loading occurs before timing.

change.reason: Explicit eligibility probe shared by all three workloads

meta.name: 黑杜林融化 · C6R5 / C6R1 结构示例
meta.note: 仅用于兼容回归与机制/UI校准。角色、装备系数和回能含示例魔法数，不是正式已验证数据。

historicalReport.meaning: Older snapshot measured before execution.detailedTraces and random critical sampling existed. Its unsupported statements are historical, not current capability claims. This new run does not overwrite or rerun it.

timingScope: simulate() including input migration, computation, hit capture and schema/integrity audits; excludes module load, summary/checks, JSON serialization, I/O, browser and Worker transport.

detailedTraceComparison.retainedCosts: Only per-hit explanation nodes are disabled. Damage events, snapshots, reaction/callback/aura/target/energy audit arrays, exact hit inputs and schema/integrity checks remain; this is not a fully log-free simulator.

rng.hash: FNV-1a 32-bit over JavaScript UTF-16 code units
rng.drawPolicy: One stream draw per eligible ordinary hit, in execution order. No draws for explicit ineligible hits or transformative reactions; explicit plugin critical-mode override is not used by this fixture.
rng.independentStreams: Critical stream is separate from particle counts, Crystallize shard positions and Dendro core positions.
rng.limitations: This measures real random critical damage decisions, not crit-trigger feedback, Favonius procs or downstream equipment/character state. No confidence interval is estimated from these 12 samples.

timing.percentileMethod: Nearest-rank p95 equals sample maximum for n=12; median averages the middle pair.
timing.distributionMeaning: Wall-clock duration distribution; not damage spread percentiles or a confidence interval for a mean.
